recommended_media: isolated SD card first; untouched eMMC fallback
preconditions: retain the successful read-only board capture and obtain serial/U-Boot access before any write
identify exact MLK-F3P-CZ02 HPF, bitstream payload/source, DTB source, kernel source/config and Module.symvers
verify driver symbol CRCs, vermagic, architecture and DT/FPGA compatible strings
obtain a version-matched Arm NN/runtime/demo/model release with provenance and license
record original boot-file hashes and obtain an external byte-level backup; current hashes are identities only
backup_and_hash_plan_not_run: read-only mount or image original boot/root media outside Git
sha256sum BOOT.bin boot.scr system.dtb kernel/rootfs identities
save U-Boot environment and serial console transcript
record media serial, partition table and free-space state
deployment_sequence_after_separate_appro: boot the isolated SD candidate while preserving the original eMMC
capture serial/U-Boot/kernel/DTB/bitstream and dmesg before module load
verify CMA and all expected DT resources
load the vendor-documented CMA allocator before applicable NPU driver(s); exact order must come from the matched release
expect only the applicable /dev/cma_mem, /dev/hard_npu and/or /dev/soft_npu nodes
run one functional vendor one-shot only after ABI, model, device and dmesg gates pass
stop_conditions: active bitstream payload/source or DTB source mapping remains unknown
module symbol CRC, vermagic or kernel config mismatch
probe error, unresolved symbol, kernel warning, crash or boot loop
any request to write eMMC, change the current system, or force-load a module

rollback.normal: power down, remove isolated SD, restore original boot selection and verify untouched eMMC hashes
rollback.boot_failure: use serial/U-Boot recovery and return to the original eMMC path; do not overwrite media
rollback.required_before_execution: documented switch position, serial access, original image backup and human approval
rollback.current_status: NOT_READY; active BOOT/DTB file hashes are read-confirmed, but FPGA payload/source mapping, kernel provenance and rollback backup remain unresolved
